title: Financial Stability Implications of Generative AI: Taming the Animal Spirits

bias_targets.methodology: Replicating a laboratory-style sequential financial trading experiment to observe whether LLM agents ignore private information signals in favor of following market trends and the past actions of other traders (information cascades).

Relabeling 'good' and 'bad' private information signals with counter-intuitive colors (e.g., using red for 'good' and green for 'bad') to evaluate if the models' decisions are distorted by pre-existing human associations rather than following objective instructions.

Endowing LLM agents with specific personal personas and characteristics (including age, gender, education, and occupation drawn from human distributions) to evaluate whether these demographic profiles impact rationality and trading behavior.
